items.title: CoolWulf AI – A personal AI assistant built in Go, optimized for macOS
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN, I've been building CoolWulf AI ( https://coolwulfai.com ), a self-hosted personal AI assistant. After seeing OpenClaw blow up, I wanted to share what I've been working on — a different approach to the same problem. *Why I built this:* I tried OpenClaw and found the Node.js/TypeScript stack heavy for what's essentially a local agent. pnpm, Node 22+, React — lots of moving parts. I wanted something that's a single binary, zero runtime dependencies, and feels native on macOS. So I built it in Go. *How it's different from OpenClaw:* - *Single binary, no runtime needed.* Download, set your API key, run. No Node.js, no pnpm, no build step. One ~100 MB binary.

excerpt_i18n.en: On February 16, ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao collaborated with China Media Group's Spring Festival Gala, offering 100,000 tech gifts to viewers nationwide and introducing various AI interactive features. Doubao disclosed that on New Year's Eve, the total number of AI interactions reached 1.9 billion. AI-powered activities such as image generation and New Year greetings attracted widespread user participation. Data shows that the "Doubao Celebrates the New Year" campaign helped users generate over 50 million festive-themed profile pictures and more than 100 million New Year greetings. This year marked the first time in the history of the Spring Festival Gala that AI was used to drive real-time interactive creation nationwide. According to ByteDance statistics, the peak TPM (tokens per minute) for Doubao's large model occurred at 21:46 on New Year's Eve, immediately after the gala hosts announced the second round of interactions using Doubao. During that minute, the model's inference throughput reached 63.3 billion tokens. ByteDance's Volcano Engine ensured the stability and smoothness of Doubao's AI interactions throughout the event through flexible computing resource allocation and deep system optimization. As the exclusive AI cloud partner for the Spring Festival Gala, Volcano Engine provided advanced multimodal large models and cloud computing support. The globally popular Doubao video generation model Seedance 2.0, even before its official release, was utilized in the visual creation of multiple gala performances. According to Volcano Engine, for the program "Song of Riding the Wind," which aimed to dynamically interpret national treasure-level ink paintings, Seedance 2.0 not only accurately preserved the brushstrokes and ink charm of the paintings but also executed a series of complex movements and camera adjustments.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de febrero, Doubao, el asistente de IA de ByteDance, colaboró con la Gala de la CCTV para ofrecer 100,000 regalos tecnológicos a los espectadores de todo el país e introducir varias funciones interactivas de IA. Doubao reveló que el día de la Nochevieja, las interacciones totales con la IA alcanzaron los 1.9 mil millones. Actividades como la generación de imágenes de IA y los mensajes de felicitación del Año Nuevo atrajeron la participación de los usuarios. Los datos muestran que la campaña "Doubao en el Año Nuevo" ayudó a los usuarios a generar más de 50 millones de avatares con temática festiva y más de 100 millones de mensajes de felicitación. Este año marcó la primera vez en la historia de la Gala de la CCTV que se utilizó la IA para impulsar la creación e interacción en tiempo real a nivel nacional. items.title: “产业出题·科技答题”2026全球开发者先锋大会正式启动
items.raw_excerpt: 2026年，全球人工智能产业迎来历史性跃迁。当“产业出题、科技答题”上升为国家战略，AI正从单纯的模型规模竞争转向科学智能、Agent智能体、端侧AI、具身智能、AI+视频等核心能力的全面突破，一场深刻的产业创新体系重构正在发生。 在这一关键时刻，2026全球开发者先锋大会（GDPS 2026）应运而生。大会将于3月27日至29日在上海徐汇西岸国际会展中心盛大举办，本次大会世界人工智能大会组委会、上海市经济和信息化委员会、上海市徐汇区人民政府联合指导，上海市人工智能行业协会主办。 全球开发者先锋大会计划于3月27日至29日上海徐汇举办，本届大会将核心主旨定位于“产业出题，科技答题”，核心愿景旨在打通产研融合瓶颈，提升从产业需求到科研成果应用效率。大会以“开发者，找找找”为主题，开展“找答案、找技术、找场景、找人才、找工作、找朋友”六大方向，促进产业资源高效对接，营造开发者创新生态，加快建成具有全球影响力的科技创新高地。 01 时代召唤：从基建扩张到能力突破的关键跃迁 回望过去数年，全球AI产业经历了大模型军备竞赛、算力基础设施快速扩张、海量语料体系建设等标志性阶段。而今，产业落地一系列崭新的产业共识正在形成。 GDPS 2026的核心使命，正是在这一历史转折点上，为全球开发者与产业界搭建一个系统级验证平台——让产业界为学术科研出题，让AI4S+Agent为产业应用答题，让技术为超级个体（SE）及开发者社区服务，通过OpenClaw和Skills市场等创新开发部署模式，驱动AI技术“落地、落细、落到产业链的每一个环节”。 02 “一核三轴”架构：系统化升级的创新体系 ■ 一核：创意落地最快之城 立足国家战略与全球视野，展现上海“产业出题，科技答题”站位担当，彰显上海作为全球科技脉搏引领者的角色，营造开发者创新生态，加快建成具有全球影响力的科技创新高地。 ■

excerpt_i18n.en:
In 2026, the global artificial intelligence industry is undergoing a historic leap. As "industry posing questions, technology providing answers" rises to a national strategy, AI is shifting from pure model-scale competition to comprehensive breakthroughs in core capabilities such as scientific intelligence, Agent intelligence, edge AI, embodied intelligence, and AI+video. A profound restructuring of the industrial innovation system is underway. At this critical juncture, the 2026 Global Developers Pioneer Summit (GDPS 2026) emerges. The summit will be grandly held from March 27 to 29 at the Shanghai Xuhui West Bund International Convention and Exhibition Center. It is jointly guided by the World Artificial Intelligence Conference Organizing Committee, the Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization, and the People's Government of Xuhui District, Shanghai, and hosted by the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Industry Association.

The Global Developers Pioneer Summit is scheduled to take place from March 27 to 29 in Xuhui, Shanghai. This year's summit positions its core theme as "Industry Posing Questions, Technology Providing Answers," with the core vision of breaking through the bottleneck of industry-research integration and enhancing the efficiency of applying scientific research achievements to industrial needs. Under the theme "Developers, Seek, Seek, Seek," the summit will focus on six directions: "seeking answers, seeking technology, seeking scenarios, seeking talent, seeking jobs, and seeking friends," aiming to promote efficient industry resource connections, foster an innovative ecosystem for developers, and accelerate the establishment of a globally influential hub for technological innovation.

01 The Call of the Era: The Key Leap from Infrastructure Expansion to Capability Breakthroughs
Looking back over the past few years, the global AI industry has experienced landmark stages such as the arms race for large models, rapid expansion of computing infrastructure, and the construction of massive language model systems. Today, a series of industrial implementations...
excerpt_i18n.es: En 2026, la industria global de inteligencia artificial experimenta un salto histórico. Con la estrategia nacional de "la industria plantea preguntas, la tecnología responde", la IA está pasando de la competencia por el tamaño de los modelos a avances integrales en capacidades clave como la inteligencia científica, los agentes inteligentes, la IA en dispositivos, la inteligencia corporeizada y la IA+video, desencadenando una profunda reestructuración del sistema de innovación industrial. En este momento crucial, surge la Conferencia Global de Desarrolladores Vanguardistas 2026 (GDPS 2026), que se celebrará del 27 al 29 de marzo en el Centro Internacional de Exposiciones Xuhui West Bund de Shanghái, organizada por el Comité Organizador de la Conferencia Mundial de Inteligencia Artificial, la Comisión de Economía e Informatización de Shanghái y el Gobierno del Distrito de Xuhui de Shanghái.

items.title: 阿里发布千问3.5，性能媲美Gemini 3， Token价格仅为其1/18
items.raw_excerpt: 2月16日除夕当天，阿里巴巴开源全新一代大模型千问Qwen3.5-Plus，性能媲美Gemini 3 Pro，登顶全球最强开源模型。千问3.5实现了底层模型架构的全面革新，此次发布的Qwen3.5-Plus版本总参数为3970亿，激活仅170亿，以小胜大，性能超过万亿参数的Qwen3-Max模型，部署显存占用降低60%，推理效率大幅提升，最大推理吞吐量可提升至19倍。Qwen3.5-Plus的API价格每百万Token低至0.8元，仅为Gemini 3 Pro的1/18。   与前几代的千问大语言模型不同，千问3.5实现了从纯文本模型到原生多模态模型的代际跃迁。千问3预训练在纯文本Tokens上进行，而千问3.5则基于视觉和文本混合token上预训练，并大幅新增中英文、多语言、STEM和推理等数据，让张开“眼睛”的大模型学会了更密集的世界知识和推理逻辑，以不到40%的参数量获得超万亿的Qwen3-Max基座模型的顶尖性能，在推理、编程、Agent智能体等全方位基准评估中均表现优异。比如，千问3.5在MMLU-Pro知识推理评测中得分87.8分，超越GPT-5.2；在博士级难题GPQA测评中斩获88.4分，高于Claude 4.5；在指令遵循IFBench以76.5分刷新所有模型纪录；而在通用Agent评测BFCL-V4、搜索Agent评测Browsecomp等基准中，千问3.5表现均超越Gemini 3 Pro、GPT-5.2。   图说：阿里开源千问Qwen3.5-Plus，性能媲美Gemini 3 Pro   原生多模态训练，也带来千问3.5的视觉能力飞跃：在多模态推理（MathVison）、通用视觉问答VQA（RealWorldQA）、文本识别和文件理解（CC_OCR）、空间智能（RefCOCO-avg）、视

excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 16, Lunar New Year's Eve, Alibaba open-sourced its new-generation large model Qwen3.5-Plus, which rivals Gemini 3 Pro in performance and tops the global ranking of the strongest open-source models. Qwen3.5 achieves a comprehensive overhaul of its underlying model architecture. The newly released Qwen3.5-Plus version has a total of 397 billion parameters, with only 17 billion activated, outperforming the trillion-parameter Qwen3-Max model with fewer parameters. It reduces deployment GPU memory usage by 60% and significantly improves inference efficiency, with maximum inference throughput increasing up to 19 times. The API price for Qwen3.5-Plus is as low as ¥0.8 per million tokens, only 1/18 of Gemini 3 Pro's price.

Unlike previous generations of Qwen large language models, Qwen3.5 achieves a generational leap from a pure text model to a native multimodal model. While Qwen3 was pre-trained on pure text tokens, Qwen3.5 is pre-trained on a mixture of visual and text tokens, with substantial additions of Chinese, English, multilingual, STEM, and reasoning data. This enables the "eyes-opened" large model to acquire denser world knowledge and reasoning logic, achieving top-tier performance comparable to the trillion-parameter Qwen3-Max base model with less than 40% of its parameters. It excels across comprehensive benchmark evaluations in reasoning, programming, and Agent intelligence. For example, Qwen3.5 scores 87.8 on the MMLU-Pro knowledge reasoning evaluation, surpassing GPT-.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de febrero, en la víspera del Año Nuevo Lunar, Alibaba lanzó la nueva generación del modelo de gran tamaño de código abierto Qwen3.5-Plus, cuyo rendimiento rivaliza con Gemini 3 Pro, coronándose como el modelo de código abierto más potente del mundo. Qwen3.5 introduce una renovación completa de la arquitectura del modelo base. Esta versión Qwen3.5-Plus cuenta con 397 mil millones de parámetros totales, de los cuales solo 17 mil millones están activos, logrando superar en rendimiento al modelo Qwen3-Max de billones de parámetros con menos recursos. La ocupación de memoria de despliegue se reduce en un 60%, la eficiencia de inferencia mejora significativamente y el rendimiento máximo de inferencia puede aumentar hasta 19 veces. El precio de la API de Qwen3.5-Plus es tan bajo como 0 por millón de tokens.

Production deployments typically use a tiered static-dynamic design: a static cache of curated, offline vetted responses mined from logs, backed by a dynamic cache populated online.
